verdict.rationale: CrewAI lets engineers restrict what an agent can do by assigning only specific required tools per task/agent and gating delegation ("Delegate tasks when allowed"), which is a form of coarse tool permissioning, but there is no evidence of sandboxed execution environments, network/filesystem isolation, or a fine-grained permission policy engine. missing for 10: sandboxed execution environment, granular per-tool permission/policy controls (e.g. allow/deny lists, resource limits), independent verification of enforcement.
